purpose: Add a genuinely combinatorial minimax contraction based on clause-variable matching. Compute the canonical matching-lean kernel by one Dulmage-Mendelsohn style alternating-reachability pass, reconstruct an explicit matching autarky for the deleted clauses, and prove that the canonical Tovey copy-cycle hard image can already be matching-lean, so this contraction is exact and useful but cannot by itself solve the universal hard core.

incidence_graph.definition: Let G=(C,V,E) be the bipartite clause-variable incidence graph: c in C is adjacent to x in V iff x or NOT x occurs in c.
incidence_graph.matched_terminal: If a matching saturates all clauses, assign each matched variable the value satisfying its matched literal. Distinct clauses use distinct variables, so the formula is SAT with an explicit polynomial witness.

dm_kernel_algorithm.step_1: Compute a maximum matching M in G.
dm_kernel_algorithm.step_2: Orient every nonmatching edge clause->variable and every matching edge variable->clause.
dm_kernel_algorithm.step_3: Let U be all clauses unmatched by M. Compute directed reachability R from U. Put C0=R intersect C and V0=R intersect V.
dm_kernel_algorithm.step_4: Let A=C\C0. Every clause in A is matched. Let X be the set of M-mates of clauses in A. Assign each x in X to satisfy the literal of x in its matched clause, remove all clauses A, and retain C0 as the kernel.

theorem.name: ONE_PASS_DM_REACHABILITY_RETURNS_THE_MATCHING_LEAN_KERNEL
proof: No variable in X is adjacent to a reachable clause. If c in C0 had an edge to x in X, then either c->x is a nonmatching directed edge and x would be reachable, or x-c is matching and reachability of c forces x reachable through the unique matched predecessor structure. Thus N(X)=A.

The matching M restricted to A-X saturates every clause of A. Setting each x in X to satisfy its matched clause therefore satisfies every clause touched by X and touches no clause of C0. This is an explicit matching autarky, so deleting A preserves satisfiability and witness reconstruction.

Let d=|C|-|M|. Every variable in V0 is matched, otherwise an alternating path from an unmatched clause to an unmatched variable would augment M. Every reached matched clause is paired with a reached variable, hence |C0|-|V0|=d. Also every neighbor of C0 lies in V0, so C0 attains the maximum Hall deficiency d.

For any clause subset S, |S|-|N(S)|<=d. Equality forces S to contain every unmatched clause and to be closed under the same alternating-reachability steps; therefore every tight S contains C0. Thus C0 is the smallest maximum-deficiency tight clause subset.

The standard matching-autarky characterization identifies this smallest tight subset with the canonical matching-lean kernel. Equivalently, if C0 had a nontrivial matching autarky, deleting its touched clauses would produce a strict tight subset, contradicting minimality of C0.
theorem.complexity: Maximum bipartite matching plus one graph reachability pass is deterministic polynomial time. The deleted assignment and later witness lifting are explicit and polynomial.

tovey_source_return_barrier.setup: Take a standard Tovey copy-cycle image of a 3-CNF hard core after trivial degree-0/1 cleanup. Let q be the number of literal occurrences/copy variables and m the number of inherited 3-clauses. There are q binary implication-cycle clauses and m inherited 3-clauses; every copy variable occurs in exactly three clauses: one inherited clause and two implication clauses.
strict_subset_argument: Let S=F\D for any nonempty deleted clause set D, and let t be the number of copy variables that disappear completely from S.
Each disappearing copy variable has all three incident clauses in D, contributing three incidences into D.

The total number of literal slots in D is at most 3|D|. If t>0 then D contains an implication 2-clause incident to a disappearing copy variable, so the slot count is strictly less than 3|D|. Hence 3t<3|D| and t<|D|. If t=0 the same strict inequality is trivial.
tovey_source_return_barrier.conclusion: Every strict clause subset has smaller deficiency, so the Tovey image is matching-lean. The canonical DM/matching-autarky contraction can therefore remove zero clauses on a full NP-hard source-return image.
tovey_source_return_barrier.meaning: Matching autarkies are a real exact polynomial preprocessor, but matching leanness is not a tractability certificate.

positive: Exact polynomial deletion of every clause outside the canonical matching-lean kernel, with explicit partial assignment and witness lifting.
Immediate SAT terminal when the incidence graph is clause-saturating matched.
A Hall/minimax invariant that is genuinely global and independent of bounded-degree Macaulay, local propagation and convex relaxations.
killed: Hope that repeated clause-variable matching/autarky stripping necessarily shrinks the canonical bounded-occurrence Tovey hard image.
Treat positive deficiency or matching leanness alone as UNSAT evidence.
not_killed: Stronger autarky systems such as linear autarkies or formula-specific nonlocal contractions.
A polynomial invariant inside matching-lean source-return cores.
Global cancellation/minimax mechanisms not equivalent to Hall matching deficiency.

next_target.name: E8_MATCHING_LEAN_HIGH_DEFICIENCY_GLOBAL_CONTRACTION_V4_7
next_target.directive: Preprocess by the exact DM matching-autarky kernel first. Then attack only matching-lean cores. Because Tovey source images can already be matching-lean, the next invariant must use sign/orientation or higher-order clause interaction beyond the unsigned incidence graph. Seek a polynomial contraction/minimax certificate with strict progress on at least one source-return family and exact witness reconstruction.
